rule: Four passes per level. (1) Fixed hall skeleton of three 10x10 chambers joined by a hall, with a coin-flip vertical variant. (2) Recursive growth: each open side gets two opposite children of one drawn even size (2, 4 or 6, weights 2:2:1), recursing with the axis flipped; up to 20 tries per side. (3) Reroll on quality: rebuild from the saved level seed until the mapped area reaches a floor; a failed stairs placement rerolls the whole level. (4) Theme slots: each eligible floor tile is tried with chance 1/freq; a candidate grows its largest free rectangle, shrinks by 2, keeps a 2-before/3-after ring clear, and must be a sealed room (cathedral: area 9 to 100). A slot draws from four good themes first, then uniformly from 17 types until one fits; unique landmarks clear a flag so they appear at most once per level. Props are placed last, with per-tier frequencies. freq 0 means every eligible tile is tried, because GenerateRnd returns 0 for values at or below 0.

data_fields.name: theme_try_chance
data_fields.unit: 1/N per eligible tile (N 0 means every tile)
